questions.question: Add gstack skill routing rules to this project's CLAUDE.md?

options.label: Add routing rules (Recommended)
options.description: Append skill routing rules to CLAUDE.md so Claude automatically invokes the right gstack skill for common requests (strategy, architecture, QA, shipping). One-time setup, committed to the repo.

options.label: No thanks
options.description: Skip — I'll invoke skills manually. (This prompt won't reappear once declined.)

questions.question: Enable cross-project learnings? gstack can apply patterns it learned from your other local projects to this review.

options.label: Enable cross-project (Recommended)
options.description: Learnings from all your local projects inform this review. Stays fully local — nothing leaves your machine. Best for solo devs.

options.label: Project-scoped only
options.description: Only learnings from this specific project apply. Better if you work across multiple client codebases where cross-contamination would be a concern.
